blocks.text: AI systems involve multiple stakeholders, each playing a key role in their creation and use. Developers design and program AI models, users interact with them in daily activities, governments regulate their applications, and communities experience their impact. Each group contributes to the overall ecosystem of AI and influences how it evolves.
Developers: Developers design and build AI systems focusing on functionality, innovation, and performance. They ensure systems are accurate, fair, and ethically developed.
Users: Users interact with AI systems and expect them to be easy to use and reliable. They are concerned about privacy, security, and correct outcomes.
Governments: Governments create policies and regulations to ensure safe and fair use of AI. They work to protect public interests and enforce legal compliance.
Communities: Communities focus on preserving social values and cultural norms. They promote responsible and ethical use of AI in society.
